resolutions.researcher_notes: No independent source confirms an operating discrete 'Tanajib-Berri gas pipeline'. Searched Aramco press, Offshore, JPT/SPE, NS Energy, Offshore-Technology, Fluor, Zawya. Sources only establish that the Tanajib Gas Plant (Marjan increment) came onstream ~2025 and that Marjan gas is piped onshore to Tanajib for processing; none states a status for a Tanajib->Berri line specifically. Seed OPEC ASB 2012/2013 citations are generic country statistics, not pipeline-specific. Marking UNRESOLVED rather than inferring 'operating'.

Fuel=Gas supported indirectly: both endpoints are gas facilities and both sources describe gas gathering/processing in this system. Offshore-Technology: oil and gas from Marjan GOSPs piped onshore to Tanajib for gas treatment/processing/NGL; Fluor: Aramco offshore gas-gathering feeds Tanajib and previously Berri/Shedgum/Ju'aymah gas plants. Neither names a single 'Tanajib-Berri gas pipeline', so this supports the commodity (gas) of the corridor, not a discrete named line.

LengthKnown=145 km has no independent support; the figure appears to be a GEM-internal estimate. No Aramco/trade/regional source quotes a length for a Tanajib->Berri gas line. Not fabricating a URL. UNRESOLVED.
Diameter=30 in has no independent support; no source quotes a diameter for this line. UNRESOLVED (no fabricated URL).

FuelSource='Tanajib Complex' (sic 'Copmplex') supported: both sources confirm the Tanajib onshore complex/gas plant as the gas handling hub for Marjan-area production (Offshore-Technology: gas piped onshore to Tanajib for processing; Fluor: gas gathered to Tanajib). Note: current sources indicate the new Tanajib Gas Plant processes this gas on-site, which weakens the premise that Tanajib merely feeds Berri via pipeline.

Endpoints independently corroborated: Offshore-Technology places Tanajib on the Persian Gulf coast of Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province (Marjan development); NS Energy places the Berri gas plant in Jubail, Eastern Province. Both are Aramco facilities. Caveat: no independent source confirms a pipeline physically connecting these two points as one 'Tanajib-Berri' line, but the stated start/end locations are correct.

Owner1=Saudi Aramco 100% strongly corroborated: both the Berri and Tanajib/Marjan facilities are wholly owned/operated by Saudi Aramco per NS Energy and JPT/SPE (and Offshore-Technology, Fluor). No competing ownership found.
